title: Hall's orders said he could never be briefed or debriefed

tellings.quote: >> I can never be briefed. I can never be debriefed. And the reason is very simple.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he served at Indian Springs, near Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada, from 1965 to 1967 and lived alongside tall white aliens there, says his orders meant he could never be briefed or debriefed. Those are the formal sessions that let someone into a secret programme and later bind them to silence when they leave. He tells Michels "the reason is very simple" and ties it to a being he calls the Teacher. If true, his work sat outside the normal rules of military secrecy.
